function.name: create_image
function.description:
Create a new image from a description, or modify an image. Use only when the user asks for an image to be produced or changed (not the character to put in a video: replace_character makes it); writing or improving a prompt alone does not mean generating. The image model only sees the images passed in source and reference: an image that is only described in the prompt is not used.
Workflows:
- 3d6f1a8c-2b7e-4f59-9c41-8e0a5d2b7c36: MOSS Image. Créer une image avec MOSS Image : affiches, mises en page et texte écrit dans l’image. (accepts: prompt only)
- fefb88eb-8311-4409-b636-6efbb42e952c: Krea 2. Créer une image : photo, illustration, ou retouche d’une image existante. Modèle d’image par défaut, rapide. (accepts: source)

prompt.description: The whole image, written for an image model that knows nothing of this conversation: three to six sentences in English. Say the subject with its concrete look (age, expression, pose, clothes, colours, materials), the place and what is behind, the framing (how close, from which angle, what is in the foreground), the light and the colours, and the kind of picture (photo with its lens and film look, illustration, painting, 3D render). Text to write in the image goes in quotes, in the language asked. Only concrete, visible things: a word like "beautiful" or "high quality" alone says nothing. Keep everything the user asked for.

function.name: create_video
function.description:
Create a video clip from a description, optionally starting or ending on given images or keeping a subject from reference images. Propose a video only when the user asks for one. To put the character of an image in place of someone in an existing video, the tool is replace_character, not this one. Every video is shown to the user, who can edit it before it runs. The video model only sees the images passed in start_image, end_image and reference: an image that is only described in the prompt is not used. When the request involves several images, pass every one of them, each in the role that fits. Before generating, agree on the video with the user in one short spoken message, without a tool: five lines at most, plain sentences, no headings, no lists, no bold. Say how you understand the clip, the length in seconds, what each image is for, then ask one to three questions only about what is still open or could be read two ways, and ask for their go. Do not write the full prompt there. Call this tool once they answered.
Workflows:
- e06b6ac9-0d3f-4538-b9ff-bf41cf3ef38f: MiniMax H3 Omni. Créer une vidéo de 5 à 15 secondes avec son synchronisé : depuis un texte, ou en gardant les sujets d’une à trois images de référence (personnages, objets, lieux). Pas d’image de début ni de fin : ce modèle (Omni-Ref) ne les suit pas, LTX 2.5 les prend. Peut aussi prolonger une vidéo et son son, à la résolution de cette vidéo. (accepts: reference)
- eaec4e2f-0649-4e56-9bd9-809dc9390452: LTX 2.5. Créer une vidéo avec son : depuis un texte, entre une image de début et de fin, avec des sujets de référence, ou pour prolonger une vidéo. (accepts: start_image, end_image, reference)

function.name: replace_character
function.description:
Replace a person of an existing video with the character of an image: the new video keeps the motion, the framing, the scene and the sound of the source video. Use when the user gives a video and wants a character in it in place of someone ("remplace le pingouin par un joueur de volley", "mets la femme de cette image à sa place"). Call it at once, without asking the user anything first. If the user gave an image of the character, pass it in reference. If not, never make one with create_image: describe the character in character, and the application makes its image, shows it to the user to keep or redo, then runs the replacement. The character takes the place, the size and the moves of the one replaced: it cannot be drawn bigger, say so if asked. To change a replacement already made, call this tool again with the same source (the video followed, not the result) and the same reference, with the change in prompt; extend_video only continues a video in time. Not to create a video from a description (create_video). The new video lasts as long as its source, up to ten seconds, and keeps its format.
Workflows:
- c4a7d2e9-3f61-4b8a-9e25-7d1c0f6b3a94: Wan 2.1 SCAIL-2. Remplacer une personne d’une vidéo par le personnage d’une image : le mouvement, le cadrage, le décor et le son restent ceux de la vidéo. La vidéo dure autant que celle qu’elle suit (dix secondes au plus) et garde sa forme. (accepts: source, reference)

function.name: create_audio
function.description:
Create music (a song with sung lyrics, or an instrumental piece) or sound effects from a description. Use only when the user asks for music or a sound to be produced; writing lyrics alone does not mean generating. Every sound is shown to the user, who can edit it before it runs. You cannot hear the result: to judge it, ask the user. For a song, write the lyrics in full yourself unless the user gave them, and pass them in lyrics.
Workflows:
- 84390db5-e4b9-413c-9352-bbac225fe79c: Bruitages (MOSS-SoundEffect v2). Créer un bruitage ou une ambiance avec MOSS-SoundEffect v2 : de 1 à 30 secondes, mono 48 kHz, sans musique ni voix chantée. (accepts: prompt only)
- 8a2e5baf-0c02-4077-b36c-482b4e54bb13: Musique (ACE-Step 1.5 XL). Composer une musique avec ACE-Step 1.5 XL : chanson aux paroles chantées ou morceau instrumental, de 10 secondes à 10 minutes, en stéréo 48 kHz. (accepts: prompt only)

prompt.description: The sound, written for an audio model that knows nothing of this conversation, in English. For music: a comma-separated list of tags, then one sentence: genre and era, mood, tempo in BPM, key if it matters, the instruments, the voice (female or male, its tone, sung or rapped) or "instrumental", and the production (lo-fi, live room, polished studio). For a sound effect: one or two sentences saying what makes the sound, the material, the action and its rhythm, the place and its acoustics (small room, open field, street), how near it is, and what comes before or after. Only concrete, audible things: a word like "epic" or "beautiful" alone says little. Never put the lyrics here.

workflow.description: The workflow that makes what the user asked for. Pass 84390db5-e4b9-413c-9352-bbac225fe79c for sound effects, noises and ambiences, without music or singing. Pass 8a2e5baf-0c02-4077-b36c-482b4e54bb13 for music: a song with sung lyrics, or an instrumental piece.

seed.description: Only when the user gives a seed number: exactly that number. Omit it otherwise; the application draws one.

seconds.description: Length in seconds: the length the user asked for, 30 at most. About 3 for a single hit or a short effect, 10 for an action, 20 to 30 for an ambience. For 8a2e5baf-0c02-4077-b36c-482b4e54bb13: Length in seconds: the length the user asked for. About 60 to 90 for a short song with a verse and a chorus, 150 to 240 for a full song; 30 when the user wants a short loop or jingle.

lyrics.description: The words to sing, in the language set in language, one line per sung line, with section tags on their own line: [Intro], [Verse], [Pre-Chorus], [Chorus], [Bridge], [Outro]. Write them in full when the user wants a song (their own words if they gave any). Empty for an instrumental piece. Never put the style here. Only for: 8a2e5baf-0c02-4077-b36c-482b4e54bb13.

language.description: Language the lyrics are sung in (fr for French). Ignored for an instrumental piece. Only for: 8a2e5baf-0c02-4077-b36c-482b4e54bb13.

Answer now without any tool, in the user’s language, as a short spoken message: five lines at most, plain sentences, no headings, no lists, no bold, no tool or argument names. Say how you understand the clip from its first moment to its last, the length you propose in seconds, and what each image is for (the image the clip starts on, the one it ends on, or a subject kept as it looks). Then ask the one to three questions whose answer would really change this video: what the request leaves open or what could be read two ways. Do not ask about what the user already said, nor about anything the images show (what a person, an object or a place looks like: you see it), and do not offer options they did not raise. End by asking for their go. Call the tool after they answer, with what was agreed. Lengths possible: MiniMax H3 Omni from 4.3 to 13.5 s (usually 5 s); LTX 2.5 from 0.3 to 9.7 s (usually 5 s).
wording.cardBrief: Nothing is generated yet. Under your next words a card shows this proposal to the user (its length, its format, its prompt) with « Générer » and « Annuler »: they decide there. Write to them now, without any tool, in their language: two to four plain sentences that say what happens in the clip from its first moment to its last, then ask whether it suits them. Never say the video is ready, made or sent: it does not exist yet. No headings, no lists, no bold, no tool or argument names.
wording.thin: Nothing was generated: the prompt is too thin for a generator that knows nothing of this conversation. Write it again in full, as the description of the prompt argument asks: what is seen, with its concrete look, the place and the light; what happens, beat by beat; the camera; the look of the picture; and for a video the sound. Take the details from the images when some are shown. Keep everything that was agreed with the user, then make the same call again.
wording.seen: Nothing was generated: you had not looked at these images yet. They are shown below. Make your call again now, writing the prompt from what you actually see in them.
wording.cited: L’utilisateur cite #ref1 ({"resource": "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"}) : ce qu’il cite n’est pas transmise à l’outil. Décrire une image dans le prompt ne la montre pas au générateur. Refais l’appel en la passant dans le rôle qui convient à sa demande (image de départ : start_image ou référence : reference).
failed: La génération a échoué et rien n’a été produit. Aucun outil n’est disponible pour la suite de ce message : explique l’échec à l’utilisateur en une ou deux phrases, sans écrire d’appel d’outil. Il relancera s’il le souhaite.
La génération a échoué et rien n’a été produit. Si l’utilisateur demande de recommencer, refais le même appel d’outil.
Cette demande n’a pas abouti : rien n’a été produit. Si l’utilisateur la redemande, refais le même appel d’outil.

function.name: local_read_output
function.description: Look at takes of this conversation (« PRISE n ») by their numbers. Pass every take to look at in takes, in one call: several takes come back together on one picture, each under its number. Reads only saved compressed copies, never the originals. A video is read as a few timestamped frames, without audio or motion. After generating an image or a video, normally finish without visual analysis. Use this tool when the user requests a check or when a specific reason makes inspection relevant to their task; do not inspect every output routinely. No generation.

takes.description: Numbers of the takes to look at, as the user says them (« les prises 47, 49 et 50 » is [47, 49, 50]).

wording.suite: Nothing was generated: the user did not ask for a longer clip. extend_video adds new footage after a clip: its result is that clip followed by the new part. To change a take or to make it again, call create_video with the whole new prompt and the same images, in the same roles as for that take. If the user does want this clip to go on, make this same extend_video call again.

function.name: create_image
function.description:
Create a new image from a description, or modify an image. Use only when the user asks for an image to be produced or changed (not the character to put in a video: replace_character makes it); writing or improving a prompt alone does not mean generating. The image model only sees the images passed in source and reference: an image that is only described in the prompt is not used.
Workflows:
- rails-image: Image locale. Creer une image (accepts: prompt only)

prompt.description: The whole image, written for an image model that knows nothing of this conversation: three to six sentences in English. Say the subject with its concrete look (age, expression, pose, clothes, colours, materials), the place and what is behind, the framing (how close, from which angle, what is in the foreground), the light and the colours, and the kind of picture (photo with its lens and film look, illustration, painting, 3D render). Text to write in the image goes in quotes, in the language asked. Only concrete, visible things: a word like "beautiful" or "high quality" alone says nothing. Keep everything the user asked for.

series.description: Only when the user asks for several images at once (« fais 10 images de ce style »): the prompts of the other images, one per image, each complete and written like prompt, which is the first image. All are made one after another with the same source, references and settings, in one call. Leave it out for a single image.
